mapper.select: SELECT S.TAX_BILL_NO, -- // 1 S.KEP_NAME, -- // 2 S.KEP_IRS_NO, -- // 3 S.KEP_SITE_NAME, -- // 4 S.ISSUE_DATE, -- // 5 S.AGENT_NAME, -- // 6 S.IRS_NO, -- // 7 S.TOT_SUPP_PRICE, -- // 8 S.TOT_TAX_PRICE, -- // 9 S.TOT_AMT, -- // 10 S.TAX_TYPE, -- // 11 S.BILL_TYPE, -- // 12 S.SUMMARY, -- // 13 S.SITE, -- // 14 S.KEP_MANAGER_NAME, -- // 15 KEP담당자명 (CONFIRM_USER_ID) '보기' AS DETAIL_VIEW -- // 16 상세내역 (하드코딩) FROM ( SELECT X.TAX_BILL_NO, X.KEP_NAME, X.KEP_IRS_NO, X.KEP_SITE_NAME, X.ISSUE_DATE, X.AGENT_NAME, X.IRS_NO, X.TOT_SUPP_PRICE, X.TOT_TAX_PRICE, X.TOT_AMT, X.TAX_TYPE, X.BILL_TYPE, X.SUMMARY, X.SITE, X.KEP_MANAGER_NAME, -- KEP담당자명 (CONFIRM_USER_ID) '보기' AS DETAIL_VIEW FROM ( SELECT TAX_BILL_NO, MAX((SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC04' AND CODE = APDT.SITE)) AS KEP_NAME, MAX((SELECT TEXT3 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC04' AND CODE = APDT.SITE)) AS KEP_IRS_NO, MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC04' AND CODE = APDT.SITE)) AS KEP_SITE_NAME, MAX(ISSUE_DATE) AS ISSUE_DATE, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM V_VOC_ICOMCMPY WHERE SYS_TYPE = APDT.SITE AND COM_CODE = APDT.AGENT_CODE)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX(IRS_NO) AS IRS_NO, MAX(TOT_SUPP_PRICE) AS TOT_SUPP_PRICE, MAX(TOT_TAX_PRICE) AS TOT_TAX_PRICE, MAX(TOT_AMT) AS TOT_AMT, MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'TX02' AND CODE = APDT.TAX_TYPE)) TAX_TYPE, MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'TX03' AND CODE = APDT.BILL_TYPE)) BILL_TYPE, MAX(REMARK_DESCRIPTION) AS SUMMARY, MAX(SITE) AS SITE, MAX(CONFIRM_USER_ID) AS KEP_MANAGER_NAME, -- KEP담당자명으로 CONFIRM_USER_ID 사용 '보기' AS DETAIL_VIEW FROM KEPTAPDT APDT WHERE STATUS <> 'D' AND IRS_NO = (SELECT IRS_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_com_code}) AND AP_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_cl_year} || #{st_cl_month} AND SITE = #{st_site} GROUP BY TAX_BILL_NO ORDER BY TAX_BILL_NO ) X ) S

/*selectSellerMpClTaxsheetIssueStateList_v2*/
SELECT X.AP_CLOSE_MONTH AS CL_MONTH /* 마감월 (IBSheet: CL_MONTH) */ , X.ISSUE_DATE /* 발행일 */ , X.TOT_SUPP_PRICE /* 금액 */ , X.TOT_TAX_PRICE /* 세액 */ , X.TOT_AMT /* 합계 */ , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.ADD_USER_ID) AS KEP_MANAGER_NAME /* Kep담당자 (IBSheet: KEP_MANAGER_NAME) */ , (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = X.ADD_USER_ID) AS KEP_MANAGER_CONTACT /* Kep담당자연락처 (IBSheet: KEP_MANAGER_CONTACT) */ , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'TX02' AND CODE = X.TAX_TYPE) AS TAX_TYPE /* 세무구분 */ , '보기' AS DETAIL_VIEW /* 상세내역 */ , '출력' AS CLOSING_STATEMENT /* 마감거래명세서 */ , CASE WHEN X.BILL_TYPE = '10' THEN '역발행' ELSE '정발행' END AS BILL_TYPE /* 발행구분 (KeP: 역발행 / 그 외: 정발행) */ , CASE WHEN X.BILL_TYPE = '10' THEN CASE WHEN NVL((SELECT DECODE(B.DTI_STATUS, 'C', 'Y', 'N') FROM XXSB_DTI_MAIN A, XXSB_DTI_STATUS B WHERE A.STATUS = 'C' AND A.SEQ_ID = X.TAX_BILL_NO AND A.conversation_id = B.conversation_id), 'N') = 'Y' THEN '수신승인' ELSE '미승인' END ELSE '-' END AS APPROVAL_STATUS /* 승인여부 (정발행: '-' / 역발행: '수신승인' or '미승인') */ , X.TAX_BILL_NO /* 계산서번호 */ FROM ( SELECT AP_CLOSE_MONTH , MAX(ISSUE_DATE) AS ISSUE_DATE , MAX(TOT_SUPP_PRICE) AS TOT_SUPP_PRICE , MAX(TOT_TAX_PRICE) AS TOT_TAX_PRICE , MAX(TOT_AMT) AS TOT_AMT , MAX(ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID , MAX(TAX_TYPE) AS TAX_TYPE , MAX(BILL_TYPE) AS BILL_TYPE , NVL(MAX(IF_SEND_FLAG), 'N') AS IF_SEND_FLAG , MAX(REMARK_DESCRIPTION) AS REMARK_DESCRIPTION , TAX_BILL_NO FROM KEPTAPDT WHERE AP_CLOSE_MONTH = #{st_cl_year} || #{st_cl_month} AND AGENT_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND STATUS != 'D'
AND (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = ADD_USER_ID) LIKE '%' || #{st_kep_manager} || '%'
GROUP BY AP_CLOSE_MONTH , TAX_BILL_NO ) X ORDER BY X.TAX_BILL_NO
